name: Default
shortDescription: Agent memory server with a REST and MCP API plus web control plane, backed by an embedded PostgreSQL database.

alerts.message: The stack starts with HINDSIGHT_API_LLM_PROVIDER set to none, which only stores and searches raw chunks. Set the provider (for example openai, anthropic, gemini or ollama) and HINDSIGHT_API_LLM_API_KEY, then redeploy, to enable fact extraction and reflect. A cloud provider with an empty key stops the API from starting.

Sign in to the web UI with HINDSIGHT_CP_ACCESS_KEY. API clients use https://<domain> as base URL and MCP clients https://<domain>/mcp/<bank_id>/, both sending HINDSIGHT_API_TENANT_API_KEY as a Bearer token.
